newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Stet -Telecom merger could take 6.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Stet -Telecom merger could take 6.

text.p: The merger of Italian telecoms holding Stet with its operating arm Telecom Italia should take about six months, the head of Italy's industrial holding IRI said on Tuesday.
"About six months for the merger is a reasonable time," IRI Chairman Michele Tedeschi told reporters.
But he said he hoped the transfer of Stet to the Treasury could take place by the end of the year.
The government said earlier this month it would merge Stet and Telecom and transfer Stet shares to the Treasury to slash IRI's debts. IRI owns some 64 percent of Stet's ordinary stock.
Stet was due to have been privatised by the end of March next year, but the government admitted earlier this month that such a timetable was now unfeasible.
